title: A sealed room: Descend fails, then the stuck state
construction: Dwarf Priest CL1, 14/14 HP, D1, in a 3x5 sealed room with no unknown grid and no staircase. The room is constructed from the M3 re-review's four starvation runs (full-3-priest-2, full-3-priest-1, full-4-necro-0, full-8-blackguard-4), where the Borg held until it starved.
limits: A unit-level reproduction of the stuck mechanism, not a recorded snapshot. The escape is search or digging (#123); the fixture pins the named stuck state and the Hold.

forbidden.item: holding in a sealed room until starvation

feasible.item: dig or search a route out (#123)
